sum: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc. focuses on stem cell and regenerative medicine-related products, wellness, and beauty encompassing from research and development, manufacturing, branding, and distribution. It has a strategic collaboration with PT Parva Candela to develop cosmetics business in Indonesia. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
ceo: Mr. Tomoki  Nagano (Founder, Group Chairman & CEO)
